name: Heterotopic Ossification
definition: Formation of mature lamellar bone in soft tissues, commonly after major trauma, hip surgery, spinal cord injury or traumatic brain injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and CT show mature ossification; earlier imaging is selected according to context.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Excision is planned selectively when mature and functionally limiting.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Asthi ectopic ossification phenotype may be documented only descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Formation of mature lamellar bone in soft tissues, commonly after major trauma, hip surgery, spinal cord injury or traumatic brain injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
